searchText: <@853943247201370112> <@690193444907515989> Titan and Ultrasound both seem to be down Titan looks OK to me. You getting an error or just no bids? just no bids last bid was several hours ago 297134 was the last slot I got a bid from Titan US even earlier and got only 2 bids today Builder was just max bidding all block value to the proposer so eventually ran out of money. Topped it up now. this is really the design blocker that I had on Prysm. I don't really know how to make an altrustic builder that is not just too dangerous. With trustless payments is a little simpler though cause you can just set your own fee recipient and bid a different value to the proposer, but I feel that any non-zero value is just too dangerous. Should be fixed on our end now as well. Thx for reporting.
